title: Therma-Tru Passage Storm Door
summary: Introducing the Passage collection, Therma-Tru's first venture into the storm door market
body_markdown:
### A Trusted Source for the Entire Entryway


Introducing the **Passage** collection, Therma-Tru’s first venture into the storm door market.


The Passage storm door collection comes in highview and midview designs, and includes six styles at a range of price points. The collection features **The Passage Core, The Passage Plus, and The Passage Premier** , as each door is made with a heavy-duty aluminum frame, dual weatherstripping, and a lifetime limited warranty.


All door styles are available in white, with select styles also offered in black, almond or brown.


[Learn more.](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261013210716/en/Therma-Tru-Introduces-Passage-Its-First-Storm-Door-Collection)
